[USER] The user is interested in finding out more about certifications like the Leaping Bunny Program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Leaping Bunny Program is a certification program that ensures products are free from animal testing and by-products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To earn the Leaping Bunny certification, companies must not conduct animal testing, use animal-derived ingredients, or animal by-products, and ensure a cruelty-free supply chain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Companies that meet these criteria are awarded the Leaping Bunny logo, which guarantees that products are cruelty-free.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] While the Leaping Bunny Program focuses on animal welfare, many certified companies also prioritize sustainability through natural ingredients, eco-friendly packaging, and sustainable practices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other certifications to look for include PETA's Beauty Without Bunnies, Vegan Society, and EWG Verified.
